description: This file defines a React component for a modal dialog that allows users to create a new user group with a name, mention, and selected users. It includes form validation, state management, and interaction with external actions to create the group.

classes.name: CreateUserGroupsModal
classes.description: A React component for creating user groups via a modal dialog, handling form input, validation, and submission.

methods.name: doHide
methods.description: Hides the modal by setting show state to false.

methods.name: isSaveEnabled
methods.description: Determines if the save button should be enabled based on current input state.

methods.name: updateNameState
methods.description: Updates the group name and mention based on user input, sanitizing mention.

methods.name: updateMentionState
methods.description: Updates the mention state based on user input.

methods.name: addUserCallback
methods.description: Callback to add users to the group.

methods.name: deleteUserCallback
methods.description: Callback to remove users from the group.

methods.name: onExited
methods.description: Handles modal exit, invoking back button callback if provided.

methods.name: createGroup
methods.description: Validates input, constructs group data, calls external create action, and handles response.
